baseline_models.focus_anchor: وآية لهم الأرض الميتة أحييناها وأخرجنا منها حبا فمنه يأكلون
baseline_models.mechanism: An unproductive ground is reactivated, what was hidden in it emerges as grain, and the grain crosses into consumers as usable sustenance. The sign is this entire causal conversion rather than a detached label.

activation_trace.role: A visibly manifest mark frames the whole conversion as something available for recognition.
Soft fertile ground supplies the material substrate whose productive capacity can return.
Uncultivated, unusable land defines death here as suspended productivity rather than vanished matter.
Earth-life through rain and fresh growth supplies the activating stage of the mechanism.
Extraction from concealment turns restored capacity into inspectable output.
The germinating grain is both the emerged product and the compact bearer of further growth.
Literal taking of food completes the mechanism by transferring revived earth's yield into consumers.

changed_reading.before: The verse reports a dead field becoming productive and supplying food.
changed_reading.after: The sign is an inspectable conversion chain: suspended fertility becomes active, concealed yield comes outside, and earth's life becomes embodied sustenance.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: وآية لهم ... الميتة أحييناها ... فمنه يأكلون
baseline_models.mechanism: The physical agricultural sequence also permits a reception model: a visible sign reactivates a deadened capacity, externalizes latent content, and supplies a beneficial share that can be taken in. Agriculture remains the literal base; the receptive transfer is exploratory.

activation_trace.role: A manifest mark supplies the communicative object that a recipient may or may not register.
The branch of a deadened, uncomprehending heart opens a cognitive analogue for the literally dead ground.
Life as benefit and good makes revival function as restored receptivity and useful response.
Bringing something out of concealment supplies the transition from latent capacity to expressed response.
An allotted edible share supplies the uptake endpoint in the receptive model.

changed_reading.before: The land is only an external proof witnessed by an already capable observer.
changed_reading.after: Its sequence can also model reception itself: a deadened capacity is enlivened, latent content becomes manifest, and a beneficial share is taken in.

context_deltas.mechanism: The surah repeatedly distinguishes warning that awakens caution from heedlessness, reminder that is followed, signs that are turned away from, and a final warning addressed to whoever is alive. This context strengthens the focus sequence as a diagnostic of whether a recipient can be activated into response.

activation_trace.role: The focus presents a manifest sign whose effect depends on reception.
Deadened understanding supplies the branch bridge from barren soil to an unresponsive audience.
Warning that wakes caution supplies the attempted activation of the audience.
Heedlessness outside alert attention supplies the inert receptive state.
A reminder that makes one remember supplies content capable of producing response.
Repeated manifest signs show that availability of evidence does not guarantee uptake.
Turning one's side away supplies the blocking action that prevents a sign from becoming assimilated response.
Warning again functions as an awakening operation at the surah's close.
The living recipient supplies the explicit condition under which warning can take effect.

structural_cues: 36:6-11 moves from heedlessness and ineffective warning to the follower of the reminder.
36:46 repeats the sign lexeme but pairs its arrival with active turning away.
36:69-70 identifies the discourse as reminder and warning for whoever is alive.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies warning, heedlessness, reminder, rejected signs, and a living addressee; I supply the analogy that soil-revival models audience-revival. A live alternative is that 36:70 means only a physically living hearer and leaves 36:33 wholly agricultural.

changed_reading.before: Revived earth furnishes evidence to observers.
changed_reading.after: Revived earth also models what successful evidence does in a recipient: it awakens capacity, produces an outward response, and contrasts with deliberate non-reception.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus's substrate-to-emergence chain recurs at human scale: the animate dead are enlivened, graves act as containing sites, sleepers are stirred, bodies slip outward, the dispersed are gathered into presence, and decayed bones are related back to first origination. Grain emergence becomes a compact rehearsal of re-creation.

activation_trace.role: Unproductive land supplies an intact but inactive substrate for the scale transfer.
Earth restored through rain and growth supplies the observable revival operation.
Passage from an interior to the outside supplies the focus's emergence geometry.
Life of animate beings transfers the focus verb from vegetation to the human dead.
Actual loss of life supplies the stronger human-scale terminus from which revival proceeds.
The grave supplies the containing interior corresponding spatially to grain held in earth.
Rapid slipping free supplies the outward motion that revises agricultural extraction into bodily emergence.
Stirring what was stationary supplies the activation step between containment and movement.
Gathering dispersed parts supplies the collective completion of emergence.
Presence, nearness, and visibility supply the destination of what has been brought out.
The explicit question of giving life to animate remains identifies the mechanism under dispute.
Decay and worn remains intensify the inactive-material state beyond the focus's barren land.
Bringing a thing into being supplies first origination as the warrant for renewed origination.

structural_cues: 36:12 repeats life and death before the focus and places deeds and traces under preservation.
36:32 and 36:53 frame the dispersed as collectively brought into presence.
36:51-52 moves bodies from graves and rest into rapid outward motion.
36:78-79 answers decayed bones by invoking their first origination.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies homologous life/death pairs, containing sites, activation, outward motion, gathering, and origination; I supply the scale-transfer arrow from seed emergence to bodily re-creation. The live alternative is that agriculture serves only as evidence by analogy, not as the same staged mechanism.

changed_reading.before: The verse demonstrates that lifeless terrain can produce crops.
changed_reading.after: Its ordered stages form a miniature resurrection model: inactive matter is activated, released from its container, restored to visibility, and gathered into a completed destination.

context_deltas.mechanism: The immediate sequel expands grain into fruit, questions exclusive human authorship, and demands gratitude. Later, provision must leave possession through spending and feeding, while the exact eating construction returns for tractable livestock. Eating therefore closes a provisioning circuit with social and ethical obligations, not merely a metabolic chain.

activation_trace.role: An allotted edible share makes distribution latent within the focus endpoint.
Repeated literal eating extends the focus chain into its immediate explanatory sequel.
Mature fruit diversifies the focus grain into a broader field of realized yield.
What hands have earned supplies the questioned claim of human authorship over the yield.
Recognition of a benefit and its giver assigns gratitude as the response to eating.
The outward passage of wealth supplies circulation beyond the current possessor.
An apportioned gift recasts agricultural output as received provision rather than absolute possession.
Feeding another supplies the social transfer that converts provision into shared sustenance.
Making a difficult resource tractable supplies the enabling relation behind animal benefit.
The repeated formula 'from them they eat' coordinates plant and animal food as parallel provisions.
Repeated recognition of the giver closes the benefits list with accountable response.

structural_cues: 36:35 repeats eating, places it beside the work of hands, and ends with a gratitude question.
36:47 links divine provision, spending, and the contested duty to feed another.
36:72 repeats the focus syntax فمنها ... ومنها يأكلون, and 36:73 again ends with gratitude.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies repeated eating, questioned hand-production, apportioned provision, spending, feeding, and gratitude; I supply the arrow that received yield entails circulation and accountability. A live alternative is that these are separate benefit lists without a single provisioning circuit.

changed_reading.before: Eating is the private endpoint of a successful harvest.
changed_reading.after: Eating marks receipt of an apportioned gift whose circuit continues through feeding others and whose proper human return is gratitude rather than exclusive ownership.

context_deltas.mechanism: The grain becomes more than present food: paired kinds grow from earth, while a neighboring sign carries descendants in a filled vessel. Branch images of hidden carrying or fruit and of scattered grain make seed and lineage cross-activate, so earth and ship appear as media that preserve multiplicity through transit.

activation_trace.role: Fertile ground supplies the containing and generative medium.
A germinating grain supplies a compact unit that is both present yield and future propagation.
A counterpart joined to its pair supplies relational generation rather than isolated production.
Vegetation emerging from earth makes the focus grain part of a larger reproductive field.
The fertile earth explicitly supplies paired growth and confirms its carrier role.
The repeated manifest-sign formula places lineage carriage in the same evidentiary series as revived earth.
An inward load, pregnancy, or fruit supplies the bridge among vessel, womb, and seed-bearing growth.
The descendant token's branch of scattered grain supplies the surprising formal bridge from posterity to seed.
A ship moving through water supplies the protective transport medium for a living line.
A filled hold supplies preservation of a multiplicity rather than carriage of a single item.

structural_cues: 36:36 immediately extends earth-growth into paired kinds.
36:41 returns to the exact وآية لهم frame and shifts the sign to descendants carried in a loaded ship.
The focus grain and the descendant root's grain-scattering branch create a packet-internal seed-lineage bridge.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies grain, paired earth-growth, an inward-load or fruit branch, descendants with a grain-scattering branch, and a filled vessel; I supply the preservation arrow that treats seed as lineage cargo. A live alternative is simple juxtaposition of agricultural and maritime signs.

changed_reading.before: The grain is an edible output for current consumers.
changed_reading.after: The grain is also a lineage-bearing unit: revival preserves and propagates life through containing media, joining present nourishment to future continuity.

context_deltas.mechanism: The next sign reverses the focus's extraction: day is stripped from night, then sun and moon proceed by measured courses and all move in an orbit. The focus's deadness and emergence therefore become phases in ordered succession, not only a one-way interruption of death.

activation_trace.role: A manifest sign establishes the category later shared by night and carriage.
Quiescence like sleep or decay permits deadness to function as a phase rather than sheer termination.
Extraction from concealment supplies the outward phase to be compared with stripping away.
The repeated visible-sign frame explicitly coordinates night with the focus earth.
Night and its darkness supply the containing phase from which brightness is removed.
Peeling off skin supplies an inverse extraction that exposes a changed state by removal.
Day opening through light supplies the phase that is alternately exposed and withdrawn.
A regular running course changes the focus transformation from isolated event to recurrent process.
Ordering by measure supplies control over the timing and bounds of each phase.
Circular motion supplies recurrence without collapse of distinct phases.
Swimming or running freely supplies continuous movement through the ordered cycle.

structural_cues: 36:33 and 36:37 share the exact وآية لهم opening.
أخرجنا منها in 36:33 and نسلخ منه النهار in 36:37 coordinate opposite extraction directions.
36:38-40 adds measured courses, non-overtaking, and orbital movement.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies mirrored extraction and bounded recurrent motion; I supply the arrow that places agricultural revival within a phase-cycle of exposure and withdrawal. A live alternative is that the verses present separate signs without one shared temporal mechanism.

changed_reading.before: Revival is a one-directional victory of life over deadness.
changed_reading.after: Revival is one ordered phase of a recurrent sign-system in which concealment, extraction, exposure, withdrawal, and return remain bounded and intelligible.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it treats green-plant-to-fire as a material analogue for dead-earth-to-food rather than as a separate proof. It remains anchored in the focus's death/life reversal and extraction from earth, and in 36:80's extraction from green wood. Downstream prose should present it as an exploratory cross-domain mechanism, not as a lexical meaning of the focus words.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: الأرض الميتة أحييناها وأخرجنا منها حبا

activation_trace.role: Apparently unusable land supplies the first material state whose latent capacity is not visible.
Fresh plant life supplies the activated state that appears contrary to dead terrain.
Extraction from hiddenness supplies the operation that discloses an unsuspected output.
Rendering a thing into a state supplies the conversion operator for the second material reversal.
A stemmed tree supplies the living material substrate of the parallel.
Fresh green vegetation intensifies the apparent opposition between moist life and fire.
Kindled fire supplies the contrary-seeming product latent in the green substrate.
Ignition supplies human access to the hidden potential once it is disclosed.

changed_reading.before: Dead land is changed into living, food-bearing land.
changed_reading.after: The sign exposes stored contraries: a substrate presenting one state can yield its apparent opposite when latent capacity is activated, as dead land yields life-food and green plant matter yields fire.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it uses the packet's non-dominant KLL mapping for focus يأكلون rather than ordinary eating semantics. It remains valid as an activation because that token is explicitly mapped to root_001315 and the surah repeatedly activates KLL totality. Downstream prose must call it a structural shadow and must never translate يأكلون as 'all,' 'completion,' or 'burden.'

activation_trace.role: The non-dominant branch of dependents and burdens makes the eaters visible as beings materially carried by the yield.
The non-dominant branch of encompassing completion makes consumption the point where the full production chain closes.
Total inclusion places life, death, deeds, and traces within an encompassing record.
Totality across paired kinds expands the agricultural chain into a whole generative system.
Every body moving in an orbit supplies systemic completeness with differentiated motions.
Every thing under final dominion and return closes the surah with comprehensive dependence.

changed_reading.before: Eating is simply the final use of the extracted grain.
changed_reading.after: In the KLL structural shadow, eating reveals humans as dependents sustained inside an encompassing system and marks the point at which its earth-to-body circuit reaches completion.

strongest_changes: The agricultural chain became a scale model of bodily resurrection: inactivity, activation, emergence, gathering, and restored presence.
Eating became accountable provisioning: yield is an apportioned gift that continues through feeding and answers in gratitude.
The neighboring sign series recast grain as lineage cargo and revival as one phase within ordered reveal-and-withdraw cycles.
summary.what_was_special: Whole-surah repetition supplied unusually exact bridges: life/death and emergence recur at human scale, فمنها يأكلون returns in the animal-benefit sequence, وآية لهم coordinates earth with night and carriage, and the split KLL mapping preserves a qualified whole-system outlier.
remaining_uncertainties: The audience-receptivity model depends on transferring physical earth-life to the living hearer of 36:70.
The seed-lineage and green-fire correspondences may be productive cross-domain analogies rather than one intended mechanism.
The KLL activation is packet-licensed but too form-distant for unqualified interpretive prose.
